messages:
emma: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR for a 'resumable stream' helper to handle streaming + pagination + retries. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542

raj: I can take the TypeScript side + tests. Quick Q: do we want both async-iterator and callback styles, or just async iterator?

emma: Prefer async iterator for TS & Py. Go should show the channel/for-loop idiom. Keep each example tiny (3–6 lines) so readers can copy-paste.

sarah: We should call out idempotency keys for reconnects — otherwise retries can double-apply side-effects.

raj: Agree. I'll include a small resume_token example and show exponential backoff. Draft TS snippet:```ts
// simplified resumable stream (illustrative)
let resumeToken: string | undefined
for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream({ model: 'x-large', prompt, resume_token: resumeToken })) {
  process(chunk.data)
  resumeToken = chunk.resume_token ?? resumeToken
}
```

mike: I'll handle Go. Suggest naming helper 'resumableStream' with a maxRetries param and surface the resume token in the example comment. Also add a short note about KV-prefix cache implications.

emma: Also add a note in migration notes: older SDKs returned raw frames; new SDKs surface resume_token on partials. Add tests that assert token preservation across reconnects.

raj: :thumbsup: I'll push the TS snippet and a small test to the PR branch.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: PR 542 updated by raj — CI: docs-snippets check started.

raj: Done — pushed TS snippet to /examples/sdk/resumable_stream.ts and a README blurb. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542/files

emma: Awesome. mike, sarah — can you aim to finish Go/Python by EOD? If not, mark WIP in PR so I can merge TS changes first.

mike: On it. Go gotcha: our Go stream yields typed messages over a channel. Short example:```go
ch := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for msg := range ch {
  // msg.ResumeToken may be set on partials
  process(msg.Data)
}
```

sarah: Python pushed as a separate commit — uses async for plus a tiny retry wrapper with exponential jitter. Commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123

emma: Perfect. I'll run a docs preview and verify snippet rendering and that the migration note is clear. One more ask: add a 'what changed' blurb in migration notes and link to the 2026.3 release notes.

raj: Added migration blurb and tests: tests/snippets/test_resumable_stream.ts

dev-bot: docs CI: preview build succeeded — https://deploy-preview-542--docs.redwood.ai/streaming/resumable.html 

emma: Thanks all — will merge once CI stays green and do a quick grammar pass. :sparkles:
